This bulletin includes coordinated influence operation campaigns terminated on our platforms in Q2 2026. It was last updated on June 30, 2026.

April

  • We terminated 13 YouTube channels as part of our investigation into coordinated influence operations linked to Argentina. The campaign was sharing content in Spanish that was supportive of a candidate in Colombia’s 2026 presidential election.
  • We terminated 110 YouTube channels as part of our investigation into coordinated influence operations linked to Chile. The campaign was sharing content in Spanish that was critical of a candidate in Colombia’s 2026 presidential election and supportive of another candidate.
  • We terminated 2 Blogger blogs as part of our investigation into coordinated influence operations linked to China. The campaign was sharing content in English and Chinese that was supportive of China.
  • We blocked 1 domain from eligibility to appear on Google News surfaces and Discover as part of our investigation into coordinated influence operations linked to the Czech Republic. The campaign was sharing content in Czech associated with Russian state media.
  • We terminated 105 YouTube channels as part of our investigation into coordinated influence operations linked to Hungary. The campaign was sharing content in Hungarian that was critical of a Hungarian political party.
  • We terminated 236 YouTube channels as part of our investigation into coordinated influence operations linked to India. The campaign was sharing content in English, Hindi, and Punjabi that was supportive of an Indian political party.
  • We terminated 992 YouTube channels as part of our investigation into coordinated influence operations linked to India. The campaign was sharing content in Hindi and Marathi that was supportive of an Indian political party.
